description: Third-party components of the web application. tools/update_web_vendor.sh writes their versions.

components.name: marked
components.role: Turns the Markdown of the documents of the notebook into HTML (the answers are rendered by the service)

components.name: DOMPurify
components.license_name: Apache License 2.0 or Mozilla Public License 2.0
components.role: Removes from the HTML of the documents of the notebook what could run code

components.name: highlight.js (themes)
components.role: Gives the colors of the code of the answers (GitHub themes, light and dark); the service colors the code

components.name: Swagger UI
components.role: Shows the interactive documentation of the interface
